63:

118: 
119: - **Outcome:** Browser/MCP mutations emit the same DAV changes as Apple mutations.

121: - **Scope:** Base event create/update/delete paths and transactional revisions.

123: - **Out of scope:** Moves, occurrences, imported feeds, sync response.

130: - **Outcome:** Apple receives only changes after its opaque token, including deletions.

140: 
141: - **Outcome:** No supported Happening mutation bypasses DAV sync.
142: - **Depends on:** T11.
143: - **Scope:** Moves, occurrence changes, supported external/imported paths, source-delete/target-create.

150: ## T13 — All-day semantics
151: 
152: - **Outcome:** All-day events round-trip without date shifts or conversion to timed events.

154: - **Scope:** DATE DTSTART/DTEND, exclusive end, timezone-independent mapping.

156: - **Out of scope:** Recurrence and floating timed events.

160: 
161: ## T14 — Recurrence semantics
162: 
163: - **Outcome:** Series and modified/deleted occurrences round-trip as one canonical resource.

165: - **Scope:** Supported RRULE, RECURRENCE-ID, EXDATE, master ETag/mutation mapping.

173: 
174: - **Outcome:** DAV matches Happening permissions and never makes imported content writable.

176: - **Scope:** Owner/editor/viewer/free-busy, revocation, imported resources, path ownership.

178: - **Out of scope:** New roles/sharing UI.
179: - **Acceptance:** Roles pass the access matrix; revocation is immediate; foreign existence is hidden; imported writes fail.
180: - **Verify:** Table-driven service/HTTP authorization tests.
181: - **Handoff:** Supply matrix and denial codes to T18/T19.

183: ## T16 — Safe client-property preservation
184: 
185: - **Outcome:** Apple edits preserve approved client-owned metadata.
186: - **Depends on:** T14.
187: - **Scope:** Allowlisted alarms, categories, URL, transparency, selected X-properties.
188: - **Changes:** Parse, validate, persist, merge, serialize allowlist; reject scheduling/unsupported components.

192: - **Handoff:** Freeze allowlist/examples for docs.

195: 
196: - **Outcome:** Users safely set up, inspect, revoke, and disconnect devices.

198: - **Scope:** Disconnected, one-time secret, connected, attention, revoke-one, disconnect-all states.

200: - **Out of scope:** Configuration profiles and Apple credentials.

202: - **Verify:** Frontend tests and Playwright lifecycle with immediate DAV failure after revoke.
203: - **Handoff:** T18/T19 reuse setup/error language.
204: 
205: ## T18 — Production hardening
206: 
207: - **Outcome:** DAV fails safely under malformed, oversized, brute-force, or insecure traffic.
208: - **Depends on:** T11, T15, T17.
209: - **Scope:** Parser/body/report limits, DAV rate limits, redacted logs, metrics, HTTPS/proxy validation.
210: - **Changes:** Add bounded middleware/parsers, safe telemetry, and fail-closed production transport checks.
211: - **Out of scope:** General observability redesign.
212: - **Acceptance:** Violations fail before writes; auth throttling is independent; logs contain no credentials/bodies; insecure production config fails closed.
213: - **Verify:** Adversarial suite, redaction/rate tests, production-config smoke test.
214: - **Handoff:** Provide operator checklist and sanitized diagnostics.
215: 
216: ## T19 — Apple compatibility, cleanup, and docs
217: 
218: - **Outcome:** Current macOS/iOS Calendar completes connect, sync, CRUD, and revoke.
219: - **Depends on:** T12, T14, T16, T18.
220: - **Scope:** Real-client acceptance, sanitized fixtures, legacy fake-CalDAV/WebCal cleanup, deployment/user docs.
221: - **Changes:** Test Apple clients; encode protocol differences as regressions; remove misleading scaffold while retaining explicit one-off ICS export.
222: - **Out of scope:** Apple credentials, Apple-side calendar creation/deletion, scheduling, tasks/journals, configuration profiles.
223: - **Acceptance:** Both clients connect; initial/incremental sync and supported CRUD work; revoke fails next request; UI/docs match reality.
224: - **Verify:** Signed device checklist, full DAV/frontend/backend suites, deployment smoke test.
225: - **Handoff:** Release only after this passes; record supported OS versions/limits.
226: 
227: ## Gate 4 summary
228: 
229: - 19 packets: 2 complete, 17 awaiting approval.
230: - 14 waves with limited safe parallelism.
231: - Highest-risk packet: T14 recurrence semantics.
232: - Release boundary: T19; earlier packets are integration checkpoints.

(End of file - total 232 lines)

230:                     }
231:                     Ok(None) => {}

233:                 }
234:             }

237:         REPORT => {
238:             let Some(authorization) = request.headers().get(header::AUTHORIZATION) else {
239:                 return dav_unauthorized();

241:             let Ok(session) = accounts.authenticate(authorization).await else {
242:                 return dav_unauthorized();

244:             let principal = match accounts.resolve_principal(&principal_id).await {
245:                 Ok(Some(principal)) => principal,
246:                 Ok(None) => return dav_not_found(),
247:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
248:             };
249:             let Ok(calendar_id) = calendar_key.parse::<i64>() else {

252:             let calendar = match accounts
253:                 .resolve_calendar(session.user_id, calendar_id)

256:                 Ok(Some(calendar)) => calendar,

260:             let path_principal_ok =

281: async fn dav_event_resource(
282:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
283:     Path((principal_id, calendar_key, resource_name)): Path<(String, String, String)>,
284:     request: Request,
285: ) -> Response {
286:     match request.method().as_str() {
287:         OPTIONS => dav_capabilities(),
288:         "GET" | "HEAD" => {
289:             let head = request.method().as_str() == "HEAD";
290:             let Some(authorization) = request.headers().get(header::AUTHORIZATION) else {
291:                 return dav_unauthorized();
292:             };
293:             let Ok(session) = accounts.authenticate(authorization).await else {
294:                 return dav_unauthorized();
295:             };
296:             let principal = match accounts.resolve_principal(&principal_id).await {
297:                 Ok(Some(principal)) => principal,
298:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
299:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
300:             };
301:             if principal.user_id != session.user_id {
302:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
303:             }
304:             let Ok(calendar_id) = calendar_key.parse::<i64>() else {
305:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
306:             };
307:             let calendar = match accounts
308:                 .resolve_calendar(session.user_id, calendar_id)
309:                 .await
310:             {
311:                 Ok(Some(calendar)) => calendar,
312:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
313:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
314:             };
315:             let path_principal_ok =
316:                 principal.user_id == calendar.owner_user_id || principal.user_id == session.user_id;
317:             if !path_principal_ok {
318:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
319:             }
320:             let Some(resource_name) = resource_name.strip_suffix(".ics") else {
321:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
322:             };
323:             let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
324:             let resource = match repository.resolve_by_name(calendar_id, resource_name).await {
325:                 Ok(Some(resource)) => resource,
326:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
327:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
328:             };
329:             let event = match EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone())
330:                 .event(calendar_id, resource.event_id)
331:                 .await
332:             {
333:                 Ok(Some(event)) => event,
334:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
335:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
336:             };
337:             let recurring: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
338:                 "SELECT EXISTS(
339:                     SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE id = ? AND recurrence_rule IS NOT NULL
340:                  )",
341:             )
342:             .bind(resource.event_id)
343:             .fetch_one(accounts.pool())
344:             .await
345:             .unwrap_or(false);
346:             if recurring {
347:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
348:             }
349:             let Some((ical, etag)) = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event) else {
350:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
351:             };
352:             let content_length = ical.len().to_string();
353:             let mut response = (
354:                 StatusCode::OK,
355:                 [
356:                     (header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/calendar; charset=utf-8"),
357:                     (header::ETAG, etag.as_str()),
358:                     (header::CONTENT_LENGTH, content_length.as_str()),
359:                 ],
360:                 ical,
361:             )
362:                 .into_response();
363:             if head {
364:                 *response.body_mut() = Body::empty();
365:             }
366:             response
367:         }
368:         _ => method_not_allowed(),
369:     }
370: }

591: fn privileges_for_role(role: &str) -> Vec<&'static str> {
592:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(role) else {
593:         return Vec::new();
594:     };
595:     let allows = |action: CalendarAction| {
596:         authorize_calendar_action(
597:             UserStatus::Active,
598:             Some(PlatformRole::User),
599:             Some(role),
600:             action,
601:         ) == AuthorizationDecision::Allow
602:     };
603:     let mut privileges = vec!["DAV:read-current-user-privilege-set"];
604:     let can_read = allows(CalendarAction::ReadDetails) || allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy);
605:     if can_read {
606:         privileges.push("DAV:read");
607:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-subscribe");
608:     }
609:     if allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy) {
610:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write-freebusy");
611:     }
612:     let writable = allows(CalendarAction::CreateEvent) || allows(CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent);
613:     if writable {
614:         privileges.push("DAV:write-content");
615:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write");
616:     }
617:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
618:         privileges.push("DAV:write-properties");
619:     }
620:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageAcl) {
621:         privileges.push("DAV:read-acl");
622:         privileges.push("DAV:write-acl");
623:     }
624:     if writable && allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
625:         privileges.push("DAV:write");
626:     }
627:     if allows(CalendarAction::DeleteCalendar) {
628:         privileges.push("DAV:all");
629:     }
630:     privileges
631: }
